scripts.auth:generate:pg: bun run auth generate --config src/db/gen/auth.pg.ts --output src/db/schema/auth.pg.ts --yes && biome check --write src/db/schema/auth.pg.ts
scripts.auth:generate:sqlite: bun run auth generate --config src/db/gen/auth.sqlite.ts --output src/db/schema/auth.sqlite.ts --yes && biome check --write src/db/schema/auth.sqlite.ts
scripts.db:generate: drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle.sqlite.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle.pg.config.ts && biome check --write drizzle
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:check && bun run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:only
scripts.test:backends: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=unused-the-app-service-is-never-started docker compose -p bunkerplan-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres valkey rustfs && BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=unused-the-app-service-is-never-started docker compose -p bunkerplan-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm rustfs-init
scripts.test:backends:down: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=unused-the-app-service-is-never-started docker compose -p bunkerplan-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run typecheck:only
